entries.root_cause: The exact-head resolver was validated by raw substring presence, so the canonical PR-head assignment could survive only as a shell comment while the executable branch resolved github.sha instead. Checkout and verification would then consistently attest a non-reviewed commit despite the expected token remaining present.
horizontal_audit: pull-request head versus event merge SHA

entries.root_cause: The project-memory job-key parser recognized inline and simple explicit YAML keys but not block-scalar explicit keys. A folded explicit key could semantically become `if` and disable the entire authority job while the validator saw only the scalar indicator.
